notes.title: Bug Fixes for AI Patch (0.2.1)
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed


 You can no longer add 5+ players when adding bots to a game.


 Description boxes now update with correct values.


 Stocks can no longer go into the negative when diminishing returns is active


 You can no longer buy more than 3 stocks when diminishing returns is active.
This one was a particularly odd one, when you would buy a stock at one price, and then diminishing returns dropped the market value then it would reset the count and allow you to buy more than 3 stocks on a button. 
Solution: The first stock you buy be the price of any additional buys, even if the market value drops 


 High score now sets properly at the beginning of a game.

notes.title: AI Patch Released (0.2.0)
notes.content:
Phew, this is without a doubt our biggest patch yet!  And with that, we officially move into 0.2 territory (WOWZA).  We're still hard at work on the story mode, but we felt that getting these changes out now could help satiate the like 3 people playing the game at this point (we love you!).

Gameplay Changes
You can now play with AI dogs!  

- Add them through the AI Options before starting a game.
- Have up to 3 AI join your match.
- Easy, Moderate, and Hard difficulty available for each.
Solo players, rejoice!  Gone are the days of competing only against your high score.  While we are still working to make the AI more robust in the patches to come, we felt that getting them out sooner rather than later would be beneficial to anyone playing solo.


Diminishing Returns GameMode (Off by default)

When on, stock price will drop slightly every time a player sells a stock.
- Can be toggled on and off (off by default) in the Adv. Options menu before starting a game.
This is a new idea that we're trying out.  Playing this mode rewards players who think quickly, and also rewards those who are patient by giving them a cheaper stock to buy.


UI Improvements
Round Counter is bigger

To help those with WEAK EYES!!


Background movement can be toggled off.

- Find it on the main menu under Options > Game > Moving Background
While we love out Earthbound-inspired backgrounds, we got some complaints that the backgrounds can cause motion sickness.


Bug Fixes / Misc
All dog bark volumes reduced by 30%

Cats meow volume reduced by 70%

We love to hear everyone BORK, I swear!  We just felt that it was... Perhaps a little too distracting.  Cats meow was particular grating, so we turned that son of a bitch wayyy down.

notes.title: Update 0.1.0 Released!
notes.content:
New Content
- NEW DOG: RADISH
- All dogs now have unique barks! Ever wanted your PizzaDog to BLUB instead of bark? No? ... Well, now it does anyway.
- Players now join by clicking start on their controller (or enter on the keyboard).
- Dogs now blink and bark on the main menu (And it's a bigger deal than you could ever imagine)
- Quarantine Mode is now available - Check it out in the advanced options!
- Players can now change the funds they begin with - Also found in advanced options.

Keyboard support now available with the following mapping
Left Buy: Z Key
Middle Buy: X Key
Right Buy: C Key
Bark: V Key
Use Ability: Space Bar
Navigate Menu's: Arrow Keys
Pause: Enter
Confirm: Enter or Z Key

Bug Fixes
- Controllers now working properly when playing over Steam Remote Play (hopefully).

Going to be honest. There was a whoooole bunch more and I didn't write them down... Whoopsies! Next time I'll make sure to keep track of them.

Removed Content
- Cerberus Ability. With the refactor we're rethinking how abilities function. Removed this for the time being, may be back in the future.
- Stock Limits . Again with the refactor this one fell under the radar. We will be adding it back in, in the future!
